nodes.name: Aggregate for Planner
nodes.notes: Aggregates both merged streams into a single item so Article Planner receives a unified data object containing both the plan and the images array.

nodes.name: Article Planner
nodes.notes: Divides the master_plan into sequential Part briefs for the AI Writer. Each Part contains a title, objectives, content outline, assigned image URL, and word count target. The Article Planner also embeds the source URL where relevant and enforces the brand voice from Set Config.

options.systemMessage:
=You are a professional content strategist. You receive a complete article master_plan and a list of generated image URLs. Your job is to divide the plan into sequential, self-contained writing briefs (Parts) for an AI writer.

OUTPUT RULES (STRICT):
- Output must be a single plain text block. No JSON. No markdown formatting outside the Part structure.
- No preamble, no explanation, no text outside the Part blocks.
- Each Part must follow this exact format:

Part X Title: [Title of this section]
Main objectives for this part: [One sentence describing the goal of this section]
Content outline:
- [Key point 1]
- [Key point 2]
- [Key point 3]
Image to use: [Cloudinary URL from the provided list, or "No image for this part."]
Target word count: [e.g., 350-450 words]

STRUCTURAL RULES:
- Strictly incremental numbering: Part 1, Part 2, Part 3, etc.
- Part 1 must always be Key Takeaways.
- FAQ must be a dedicated Part — write out each question exactly as an H3.
- Final Part must be Next Steps / CTA.
- Max 700 words per Part.
- Sum of all Parts must reach the target word count from the plan.
- Assign each image URL to the most contextually relevant Part. Use each URL exactly once. Never reuse a URL.
- If no images are available, write "No image for this part." for all Parts.
- Language must match the language field from the plan.
- Do NOT invent statistics, quotes, or URLs not provided in the plan.

nodes.name: OpenAI — Article Planner
nodes.notes: LLM for Article Planner. gpt-4.1-mini is sufficient for plan division and brief generation.

nodes.name: Brave Search1
nodes.notes: Fetches latest news from Brave Search. Returns up to 20 results; the next node filters to top N defined in Set Config.

nodes.name: Format Search Results1
nodes.notes: Filters to top N results and formats them as a structured string for AI agents. Retains raw array for reference.

nodes.name: Idea and Plan Agent1
nodes.notes: Selects the most compelling news story and generates the complete article blueprint: master_plan, image_prompts array (one per body image), and header_image_prompt. Output quality here drives everything downstream.

options.systemMessage:
You are a senior content strategist and article planner. You receive a single editorial brief and produce a complete, execution-ready article blueprint.

Hard rules:
- Output MUST be valid JSON only. No markdown. No code fences. No extra text.
- Do NOT invent statistics, quotes, studies, or URLs not present in the brief.
- Do NOT write the final article HTML.
- master_plan must be explicit enough for a planner agent to split into sections without guessing.
- image_prompts must be an array of exactly N detailed English prompts for an AI image generator (N = image_count from config). Each prompt must describe a photorealistic editorial image matching a specific article section.
- header_image_prompt is a single prompt for the wide-format featured image. Set to empty string if use_header_image is false.
- image placement: for each prompt in image_prompts, state the exact H2/H3 heading it belongs after inside master_plan.

nodes.name: OpenAI — Plan Agent1
nodes.notes: LLM for Idea and Plan Agent. gpt-4.1-mini for cost efficiency. Swap to gpt-4.1 for higher quality planning.

nodes.name: Create JSON1
nodes.notes: Parses the raw JSON string output from Idea and Plan Agent into a structured object. Applies multiple fix strategies for common LLM formatting issues (smart quotes, code fences, trailing commas). Throws a descriptive error if parsing fails completely.

Rules:
- Select exactly 3 articles.
- Do NOT invent statistics, quotes, or URLs not present in the input.
- Rank 1 = best candidate for immediate publication.
- title must be max 60 characters and SEO-optimized.
- description must be actionable — enough for a planner agent to build a full outline from it.

parameters.content:
## Trigger and configuration

Fires on schedule and loads all settings — search query, brand brief, word count, and API credentials — into a single config object used throughout the workflow.

## News fetch and topic selection

Fetches latest news via Brave Search, formats the top results, and uses GPT-4.1-mini to select the 3 best topics for long-form articles.

## Article loop

Iterates over each selected topic one at a time. On completion, aggregates all results and triggers the final notification.

## Pipeline completion notification

Aggregates all processed articles, generates a plain-text summary with GPT-4.1-mini, and sends it to Telegram confirming how many articles were published and their titles.

## Article planning

Prepares the article brief for the current loop item. Idea and Plan Agent generates the full blueprint — master plan, image prompts, and SEO metadata.

## Image generation and merge

Generates body images from AI prompts, uploads them to WordPress, and merges the image URLs back with the article plan before writing begins.

## Article structure planning

Divides the master plan into sequential part briefs. Each part is split out individually and passed to the writer one section at a time.

## Article writing

Writes each section as HTML based on its part brief. All parts are aggregated, assembled into the full article, and cleaned before publishing.

## WordPress publishing

Publishes the article as a draft, adds the excerpt and slug, generates the header image, and attaches it as the featured image.

## AI article generation pipeline

### How it works

1. Schedule Trigger fires daily and Set Config passes all configuration — search query, brand brief, word count, and credentials — to every downstream node.
2. Brave Search fetches the latest news articles. Make summary uses GPT-4.1-mini to select the top 3 most suitable topics and structures each into an editorial brief.
3. The loop processes each article brief individually. Set Data in Loop isolates the current item. Idea and Plan Agent generates the complete article blueprint — master plan, image prompts, and header image prompt.
4. Images are generated in parallel via OpenAI, uploaded to WordPress, and merged back with the plan before the Article Planner splits the blueprint into sequential writing briefs.
5. Article writer generates each section as HTML, one part at a time. All parts are aggregated and assembled into the full article.
6. The article is published to WordPress as a draft with excerpt, slug, and featured image attached.
7. After the loop completes, Create Notification generates a summary and sends it to Telegram.

### Setup

- [ ] Connect your Brave Search API credential to the Brave Search node.
- [ ] Connect your OpenAI API credential to all OpenAI model nodes.
- [ ] Connect your WordPress API credential to all WordPress nodes.
- [ ] Connect your Telegram Bot credential and verify the Chat ID in Set Config.
- [ ] In Set Config, update search_query, brand_brief, wordprees_blog_url, and cloudinary settings.
- [ ] Set the Schedule Trigger to your preferred execution time.

### Customization

Edit search_query in Set Config to change the topic. Adjust brand_brief to change the writing style. Modify target_word_count to control article length.
